name: Retrieves Source From
description: A CodePipeline pipeline retrieves its source artifact from an S3 bucket (pipeline -> bucket): the pipeline's S3 source action. The pipeline initiates the pull (edge direction); the source object flows from the bucket back to the pipeline, a data-backwards edge, which the `_FROM` marks. Its own relationship, apart from RETRIEVES_CONTENT_FROM (a CDN fetching an origin).
